# AntiReducedDebugInfo

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** AntiReducedDebugInfo

## What it does

Some servers turn on Minecraft's "reduced debug info" mode, which strips down the F3 debug screen so you can't see useful details like your exact coordinates, the block you're looking at, or chunk and biome data. This is often done to make navigation and cheating harder for players. AntiReducedDebugInfo ignores that restriction and restores the full debug screen, giving you back the complete F3 readout regardless of what the server requests.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/antireduceddebuginfo). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
